name: M N C Wireless Berhad
overview: 今年公司完成配股发行（Rights Issue with Warrants），并持续推进与 Sanichi Property 关于 Marina Point 120 个单位在线租赁或短期豪华租赁服务的谅解备忘录（MOU），但截至最新公告该 MOU 无重大进展。此外，公司提出削减最多 RM83.00 million 已发行股本的议案。
overview_en: During the year, the Company completed a Rights Issue with Warrants and continued to pursue a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Sanichi Property for online leasing or short-term luxury rental services for 120 units of Marina Point, though no material development was announced as of the latest update. The Company also proposed a reduction of up to RM83.00 million of its issued share capital.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司层面完成配股发行，并提出股本削减议案；与 Sanichi Property 的 MOU 持续更新但无重大进展。
segments.note_en: At the company level, the Rights Issue with Warrants was completed and a share capital reduction was proposed; the MOU with Sanichi Property continued to be updated with no material development.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 配股发行（Rights Issue with Warrants）完成，705,254,144 股配股股份及 235,084,703 份凭单 D 于 2026 年 5 月 15 日上市。
actions.text_en: The Rights Issue with Warrants was completed with 705,254,144 Rights Shares and 235,084,703 Warrants D listed on 15 May 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 配股发行（Rights Issue with Warrants）认购率达 98.77%，共收到 705,254,144 股配股股份的有效接纳及超额申请。
actions.text_en: The Rights Issue with Warrants achieved a subscription rate of 98.77%, with valid acceptances and excess applications for a total of 705,254,144 Rights Shares.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 配股股份发行价定为每股 RM0.04，凭单 D 行使价定为每份 RM0.04。
actions.text_en: The issue price of the Rights Shares was fixed at RM0.04 per Rights Share and the exercise price of Warrants D at RM0.04 per Warrant D.
